🏛️ Institutional Profile & Academic Heritage

Official background, national accreditation, and industrial synergies for University of Science and Technology of China (USTC).

Direct Executive Summary: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) (中国科学技术大学) is a national Double First-Class (Class A) and Project 985 research institution in Hefei, ranked QS #133 | Nature Index #2 Global | C9 League Founder globally. Operating under official MOE Agency Code 10358, University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) provides fully funded CSC Type B scholarships, Silk Road fellowships, and university presidential awards featuring 100% tuition exemption, campus accommodation, and up to 3,000 – 7,000 RMB / mo stipend with no IELTS required for English-taught applicants.

🎯 2027 / 2028 Admissions & Scholarship Highlights

Active Application Window

International applicants applying under Agency Code 10358 qualify for a 100% Full Tuition Waiver, Free International Student Accommodation, and a monthly cash living allowance of 3,000 – 7,000 RMB / mo. Applicants can calculate their GPA qualifications using our free China Scholarship Eligibility Checker, download verified Foreigner Physical Examination Forms, and review the official CSC Step-by-Step Submission Roadmap. English-medium graduates qualify for an IELTS waiver via an official English Proficiency Certificate (EPC).

🎯 Check Eligibility🏛️ CSC Type B Guide📄 Download Medical PDF💰 Cost of Living in Hefei📝 Apply Admissions Desk

The University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), founded in Beijing in September 1958 by the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) under scientific legends Guo Moruo, Qian Xuesen, Yan Jici, and Hua Luogeng, relocated to Hefei, Anhui Province in 1970. As a founding pillar of China's elite C9 League and a designated Double First-Class National University, USTC was created with the strategic mission of cultivating top-tier talent in frontier science and strategic high-technology to meet national defense and modernization requirements. USTC stands at the pinnacle of global scientific discovery, ranked #2 worldwide in the Nature Index for natural sciences output and holding the highest per-faculty research citation count across mainland China. The university is home to groundbreaking national facilities, including the National Synchrotron Radiation Laboratory (NSRL), the Hefei National Laboratory for Physical Sciences at the Microscale (HFNL), and the CAS Center for Excellence in Quantum Information and Quantum Physics. Spearheaded by world-renowned academician Pan Jianwei, USTC scientists successfully engineered the world's first quantum communications satellite ('Micius') and achieved quantum computational supremacy with the 'Jiuzhang' photonic and 'Zuchongzhi' superconducting quantum computers. Through its International College, USTC offers an expansive array of 100% English-taught Master's and Doctoral programs spanning quantum information, artificial intelligence, nanomaterials, and green energy across its East, West, Central, South, and High-Tech Gaoxin campuses, along with the Suzhou Institute of Advanced Research (SIAR). International scholars enjoy comprehensive funding through the Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B - Agency Code 10358), the institutional USTC Fellowship (Level A and Level B), and the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents, with doctoral stipends reaching up to 7,000 RMB monthly. Moreover, USTC operates a student-friendly centralized admissions process where finding an academic supervisor in advance is not mandatory for initial application submission.

💰 Available Scholarships & Financial Coverage (2027 / 2028)

Government, municipal, and enterprise-funded grants supporting international students at University of Science and Technology of China (USTC).

Direct Financial Summary: Full scholarships at University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) cover 100% tuition fees, free university student dormitory (single room for PhD, double for Master's), comprehensive medical insurance, and a monthly tax-free living stipend of 3,000 – 7,000 RMB / mo under official Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B) and presidential fellowship quotas.

Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B - Agency Code 10358)

✔ 100% Tuition Waiver + Free Single/Twin Campus Apartment + Comprehensive Medical Insurance💵 3,000 RMB/month for Master's | 3,500 RMB/month for Doctoral Scholars

Official Ministry of Education bilateral postgraduate scholarship administered directly by USTC under Agency Code 10358. Covers full tuition, university accommodation on Hefei campuses, complete medical insurance, and a monthly living allowance through the Campus China (CSC) portal.

USTC Fellowship (Level A - Full Sponsorship)

✔ Full Tuition Exemption + Free International Scholar Residence + Comprehensive Medical Health Plan💵 Up to 3,000 RMB/month for Master's | Up to 7,000 RMB/month for Doctoral Fellows

Prestigious institutional fellowship established by USTC and the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS) to attract exceptional international researchers into high-priority STEM laboratories. Outstanding PhD researchers receive top-tier research subsidies up to 7,000 RMB per month.

USTC Fellowship (Level B - Tuition & Health Waiver)

✔ 100% Tuition Exemption + Comprehensive International Student Medical Insurance💵 Tuition-free study (Living expenses and accommodation self-supported or subsidized)

Academic merit scholarship awarded to high-achieving international students covering full tuition and medical coverage, allowing recipients to pursue postgraduate degrees with minimal financial overhead while staying in low-cost Hefei.

ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents

✔ Full Tuition Waiver + Campus Housing Subsidy + Health Insurance + International Airfare Allowance💵 3,000 RMB/month for Master's | 6,000 – 7,000 RMB/month for PhD Fellows

Global scholarship funded by the Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) and CAS for outstanding students from developing and Belt & Road nations to pursue graduate degrees at USTC and CAS institutes.

Anhui Provincial Government International Scholarship

✔ Annual Living & Academic Subsidy (20,000 RMB for Master's | 30,000 RMB for PhD)💵 Lump-sum annual grant disbursed directly to student bank accounts

Provincial merit grant disbursed by the Department of Education of Anhui Province to incentivize outstanding international students pursuing full-time degree studies in Hefei.

📋 Eligibility Criteria & Document Checklist

Verified requirements mandated by the Ministry of Education of China and University of Science and Technology of China (USTC).

Direct Eligibility Summary: Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0 (75%+). Age limits are strictly enforced: Bachelor's (18–25), Master's (under 35), and PhD (under 40). Verify your eligibility instantly via our Online Eligibility Calculator.

✔Non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign passport with good mental and physical health, having no criminal record.
✔Educational background: High school diploma for Bachelor's applicants (under 25); Bachelor's degree for Master's applicants (under 35); Master's degree for Doctoral applicants (under 40).
✔Language proficiency: For English-taught programs, IELTS 6.0+, TOEFL 86+, or an official English Proficiency Certificate (EPC) issued by your prior degree-awarding university proving instruction in English. For Chinese-taught programs, HSK 5 (minimum 180).
✔Academic transcripts and highest graduation certificates: Notarized English or Chinese translations with minimum GPA of 3.2/4.0 or 80%+ equivalent.
✔Two letters of recommendation written in English or Chinese by professors or associate professors with institutional contact details and signatures.
✔Comprehensive study plan or research proposal (minimum 800 words for Master's, 1,500+ words for PhD outlining specific research scope, methodology, and target laboratory alignment).
✔Valid Foreigner Physical Examination Form with complete blood tests (HIV, Syphilis, Hepatitis), chest X-ray, and official hospital stamp within 6 months of application.
✔Host Supervisor Policy: Finding a supervisor before applying is optional; USTC International College automatically routes complete applicant dossiers to respective academic schools for faculty review and evaluation.

🍜 Campus Living, Halal Dining & City Transit

Accommodations, dietary options, and transportation in Hefei, Anhui Province.

Direct Student Life Summary: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC) provides international student accommodation with private bathrooms and high-speed internet, certified on-campus Halal canteens, and convenient transit links. Read our detailed Cost of Living Guide and Campus Life & Halal Food Guide.

🏢

Student Residences

International scholars are housed in dedicated international student apartment buildings across East and High-Tech campuses. Rooms feature private ensuite bathrooms, air conditioning, central heating, broadband fiber, study desks, and communal kitchens and laundry rooms on every floor.

🍲

Halal Dining Options

USTC provides certified Halal dining halls (清真餐厅) at both East and West campuses, serving freshly prepared Uyghur, Hui, and Central Asian halal cuisines including beef hand-pulled noodles, lamb pilaf, and seasoned stir-fries at subsidized university rates.

🚇

Metro & Transit

Campuses are seamlessly connected to the Hefei urban transit network via Hefei Metro Line 3 and Line 2, with direct stations near East and West campus gates enabling rapid 25-minute transit to Hefei South High-Speed Railway Station.

💰

Cost of Living

Hefei is one of China's most student-friendly provincial capitals, where living expenses average between 1,200 and 1,800 RMB monthly. International scholars receiving the 3,000–3,500 RMB CSC or up to 7,000 RMB USTC fellowship easily save substantial portions of their monthly allowance.

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Everything international applicants need to know about University of Science and Technology of China (USTC).

Q: What is USTC's official Agency Code for the Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B)?

USTC's official Agency Code for the Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC Type B) is 10358. When completing your application on the official CSC portal (campuschina.org), select 'Program Category Type B' and enter Agency Code 10358 to ensure your application dossier is routed directly to the USTC International College admissions committee in Hefei.

Q: Do I need to secure an acceptance letter from a USTC professor before applying?

No, finding a host supervisor in advance is not mandatory at USTC. Unlike many other Chinese universities, USTC's International College allows prospective international students to submit their complete online application directly through the USTC system (isa.ustc.edu.cn). Once submitted, the admissions office coordinates with relevant academic departments and professors to evaluate candidate dossiers and arrange academic interviews. However, if you already have contact with a professor who agrees to supervise you, uploading a provisional acceptance form is welcome and strengthens your profile.

Q: Can I apply for English-taught graduate programs at USTC without IELTS or TOEFL?

Yes. USTC accepts an official English Proficiency Certificate (EPC) issued by your previous university certifying that your undergraduate or postgraduate degree was taught and evaluated entirely in English. Submitting an EPC waives the requirement for standard standardized tests such as IELTS or TOEFL, giving qualified applicants a straightforward admissions pathway.

Q: What is the difference between USTC Fellowship Level A and Level B?

USTC Fellowship Level A provides comprehensive full funding matching or exceeding the CSC standard, including a 100% tuition waiver, free on-campus international student accommodation, medical insurance, and a monthly living allowance of up to 3,000 RMB for Master's students and up to 7,000 RMB for Doctoral candidates. USTC Fellowship Level B is a partial scholarship that covers full tuition and medical insurance, but requires recipients to cover their own accommodation and personal living costs.

Q: What is the ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents at USTC?

The ANSO Scholarship for Young Talents is a prestigious international fellowship funded by the Alliance of International Science Organizations (ANSO) in partnership with the Chinese Academy of Sciences (CAS). Hosted at USTC, it supports up to 200 Master's and 300 Doctoral students annually from developing nations and global partners, offering full tuition waiver, monthly stipends (3,000 RMB for Master's, 6,000–7,000 RMB for PhD), health insurance, and round-trip international travel allowance.

Q: What are the key application deadlines for USTC international graduate scholarships?

Applications for the Autumn (Fall) intake at USTC generally open on October 16 and close on January 31 for full scholarship consideration (CSC Type B, USTC Fellowship Level A, and ANSO). Academic departments conduct online technical interviews and document assessments between February and April, with official admission notices and JW202 visa forms dispatched between June and July.

Q: How can I apply through the China Scholarships Portal admissions desk for USTC?

You can initiate your application by clicking 'Apply Now' on this page to submit your academic transcripts, degree diplomas, and CV through our secure Online Application Form. Our admissions advisors will evaluate your qualifications, assist with your research proposal and supervisor alignment, verify your EPC certificate, and guide you step-by-step through both the USTC portal (isa.ustc.edu.cn) and the CSC system. You can also reach our team directly on WhatsApp at +92 370 4018567.
